## Purpose
The third-party libraries available to generated tool code: requests, pandas, numpy, beautifulsoup4, lxml and sqlalchemy.

## Accuracy
- **It is mostly accurate against `synthesis/policy.ALLOWED_THIRD_PARTY`** (requests, pandas, numpy, bs4, lxml).
- **`sqlalchemy` is installed but listed in `FORBIDDEN_MODULES`,** so generated code can never import it. It is presumably here only because the service itself needs it.

## Used by
The Dockerfile (`pip install -r sandbox_requirements.txt`) and the policy allow-list.

## Replication notes
Keep this list in step with `ALLOWED_THIRD_PARTY`. Installing a library here is what makes an allowed import actually loadable in the sandbox.
